An '''Aurilian fruit''' was a type of [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] that was picked from an [[Aurilian plant]], a notoriously fickle and difficult plant to grow to fruition. The nectar from this fruit provided a vitalizing rush to those that consumed it.
